label: Обо мне
description: Prepositional sentences that train 'about me' after о/обо in real conversation.

missions.phrase: Кажется, обо мне опять говорят.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: About-me reference. 'Обо мне' is the standard prepositional shape that 'о' takes before the pronoun 'мне', and 'говорят' is plural with an unspecified subject. The line trains the core idea of being discussed.

missions.phrase: Они постоянно говорят обо мне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional phrase with plural subject. 'Обо мне' is the object of discussion in the prepositional case, and 'говорят' is plural present. 'Они' makes the speakers explicit.

missions.phrase: Брат часто думает обо мне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Reference after a mental verb. 'Обо мне' is the prepositional form after 'о', and 'думает' is third-person singular. The verb думать takes 'о' plus the prepositional case for its topic.

missions.phrase: Эта песня как будто обо мне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Noun phrase with prepositional complement. 'Обо мне' describes the topic of the song, modifying 'песня'. The line shows that prepositional phrases can attach to nouns, not only verbs.

missions.phrase: Это книга обо мне и моей семье.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Written about the speaker. 'Обо мне' names the subject matter of the noun 'книга', and the phrase extends with 'и моей семье' in the prepositional case after the same 'о'. Both objects share one preposition.

missions.phrase: Соседи всё время спрашивают обо мне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Query or concern. 'Обо мне' is the topic being asked about, and 'спрашивают' is plural present. The verb спрашивать takes 'о' plus the prepositional case, making this a natural social line.

missions.phrase: Здесь никто ничего не знает обо мне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Negation with a prepositional phrase. 'Обо мне' stays after 'о' even under negation, and 'никто не знает' builds a double-negative frame typical of Russian. The complement remains stable.

missions.phrase: Сейчас все думают только обо мне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Generalized subject plus prepositional object. 'Обо мне' is the topic, and 'все думают' gives a broad subject. 'Только' sharpens the focus while keeping the prepositional placement clear.

missions.phrase: Мама всегда заботится обо мне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Care and responsibility. The verb 'заботиться' governs 'о' plus the prepositional case, so 'обо мне' names the person cared for. The line is warm, common, and easy to memorize.

missions.phrase: Друзья много рассказали обо мне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past-tense reporting. 'Обо мне' stays in the prepositional form, and 'рассказали' is plural past. 'Много' adds a natural quantity sense to the report.

missions.phrase: Этот фильм почти полностью обо мне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Topic naming. 'Обо мне' labels the subject of the noun 'фильм', and 'почти полностью' qualifies how much. The line shows a prepositional complement modifying a noun.

missions.phrase: В газете вышла статья обо мне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Written description. 'Обо мне' modifies 'статья', and 'в газете' adds a second prepositional phrase marking where it appeared. Two prepositional phrases sit comfortably together.

missions.phrase: Они знают обо мне слишком много.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional topic plus intensifier. 'Обо мне' is the target of knowledge, and 'знают' is plural present. 'Слишком много' adds a natural everyday evaluation.

missions.phrase: В офисе мало говорят обо мне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Quantifier plus prepositional phrase. 'Обо мне' stays in the prepositional case, and 'говорят' has an unspecified subject. 'Мало' adds a quantitative judgment and 'в офисе' sets the scene.

missions.phrase: На работе хорошо говорят обо мне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Positive evaluation. 'Обо мне' is the topic, and 'говорят' keeps the line conversational. 'Хорошо' gives a quality judgment while 'на работе' anchors the setting.

missions.phrase: Мне интересно, что говорят обо мне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative experiencer plus prepositional clause. 'Мне интересно' frames the reaction, and the clause 'что говорят обо мне' supplies the content. The line combines two high-value structures.

missions.phrase: Я помню всё, что говорили обо мне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Memory and reported speech. 'Обо мне' stays stable after 'о', and 'говорили' is past plural with an unspecified subject. The line is useful for narrative practice.

missions.phrase: У них накопились вопросы обо мне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Noun phrase with prepositional complement. 'Обо мне' modifies the plural noun 'вопросы', and the existential 'у них' shows who has them. The complement attaches naturally to the noun.

missions.phrase: Коллеги до сих пор спорят обо мне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional phrase with plural verb. 'Обо мне' is the topic, and 'спорят' is plural present. 'До сих пор' adds duration and makes the line sound like real social life.

missions.phrase: Перестаньте шептаться обо мне!
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Imperative plus prepositional phrase. 'Обо мне' stays after the preposition, and 'перестаньте шептаться' is a natural plural imperative with an infinitive. The line shows the complement holding firm under a command.
